name: Guardian Angel
source: As an ex-special forces soldier, a brash, rich, playboy artist wants to hire you as his personal bodyguard. What's more, you're feeling drawn closer to the widowed husband of your former commander.
translation: 作为一名前特种部队士兵，一位傲慢、富有、花花公子的艺术家想雇用你作为他的私人保镖。更重要的是，你感觉与你的前指挥官的寡居丈夫的关系更加亲近。
